payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: What is the mug’s position relative to the headphones in the edited image?
node.criteria: complete if the mug is to the right of the headphones; partial if it has moved toward the right but is not to their right; absent if there is no progress toward moving it right; unknown if the image does not provide sufficient evidence. Unrelated edits do not count as progress.

The traces repeatedly claim the mug is right of the headphones, but the edited image visibly contains two mugs: one left of/overlapping the headphones and another to their right, while the source has one mug. This makes object identity and whether the requested mug was moved ambiguous; do not treat the right-side mug alone as proof of completion or infer partial solely from the reference label. Add a criterion to track the source mug across the edit and assess its displacement relative to the headphones, distinguishing a moved original from a duplicated/new mug; use partial only when evidence shows progress that falls short, and unknown when identity/progress cannot be established. The five identical high-confidence traces are repeated judgments, not independent evidence. No transport or dependency failure is reported; the issue is visual grounding and criterion ambiguity."}
